persons.name: Lakṣmīdhara
persons.evidence: liṣiti vidyāpiyā karmmācarya, lakṣmīdharana saṃpurṇṇa yāṅā juro

notes: The manuscript was completed in NS 834 (c. 1714 CE) by the Karmācārya Lakṣmīdhara of Vidyāpī(ṭha). An enigmatic preceding or additional note records 'saṃvat 832 vakādharaṃ dāṅāyā hlāṣa', which might refer to a person Vakādhara and a date NS 832 (c. 1712 CE) relating to an exemplar, receipt, or pledge.
